6:111: Xas Nekwni Nessers asen d lmalayek, u mmeslayen asen d lmeggtin, u Nefser asen d, yal cci, zdat sen, ur ţţamnen, siwa ma ihwa yaS i Ṛebbi. Maca, aṭas degsen ur ssinen.
6:112: Akka ay Nerra, i yal nnbi, acengu. Ccwaṭen, seg imdanen akw si leonun, ţţemweḥḥin garasen awal uziyn i uɣuṛṛu. Lemmer i S ihwi, i Mass ik, ur ţ xeddmen. Ihi, eoo iten ar wayen d snulfuyen,
6:113: iwakken ad mmalen ɣuṛes ulawen n wid ur numin s laxeṛt, a t ṛaḍin, ad gemren ayen zerɛen.
6:114: Day bɣiɣ amḥaddi, war Ṛebbi? D Neţţa i wen d Issersen Tazmamt, s ussefhem. Wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt, ẓṛan, ar neţţat, ters ed sɣuṛ Mass ik, s tideţ. Ur ţţili seg wid iţcukkun.
6:115: Awal n Mass ik ibbweḍ, s tideţ akked lmizan. Ur illi ubeddel deg wawal iS. Neţţa Issel, d Amusnaw.
6:116: Ma tuɣeḍ awal i tegwti n wid illan di tmurt, a k telfen seg ubrid n Ṛebbi. Teddun kan d wayen nwan. Nitni snulfuyen d kan.
6:117: Ih, Mass ik Issen sennig akw, anwi innetlafen seg ubrid iS. Neţţa Issen sennig akw, anwi iţwanhan.
6:118: Eččet ayen iɣef d immekti isem n Ṛebbi, ma tumnem s issekniyen iS.
6:119: Acu ikwen iuɣen, ur teţţeţţem ara seg wayen iɣef d immekti isem n Ṛebbi? Niɣ Issfehm awen ayen i wen Igdel, siwa ma iţwaḥeţţem fellawen. Ih, aṭas ay tellifen, s zzhu nnsen, war tussna. Niɣ Mass ik Iugar akw akken Issen wid izegren tilas.
6:120: Ekkset abekkaḍ uḍhiṛ akked uffir. Ih, wid ibbwin abekkaḍ, ad ţţuqeṭṭin ɣef wayen xeddmen.
6:121: Ur teţţet ayen iɣef ur d immekti ara, isem n Ṛebbi. Ih, ayagi d ixmiṛ. Ih, ccwaṭen ţweḥḥin i imeddukwal nnsen, a kwen namren. Ma tuɣem asen awal, kunwi, s tideţ, tcurkem.
6:122: Ma win illan d lmegget, Nessider it id, Nga yas tafat, iteddu yis ger medden, day d amedya s, win illan di tillas, ur izmir ad iffeɣ segsent. Akka, iţţucebbeḥ i ijehliyen, wayen xeddmen.
6:123: Akka ay Nerra, ad ţţandin di yal tamdint, ibeɣwḍiyen is, uqsiḥen maḍi. Pţandin kan i iman nnsen, ur faqen.
6:124: Ma iusa ten id ussekni, ad inin: "ur neţţamen, alamma iusa yaɣ d ayen id iusan ar imazanen n Ṛebbi". Ṛebbi Yif akw akken Issen, anida ara Ifk tabṛaţ iS. Ad iṛxisen, ar Ṛebbi, wid ibeɣwḍen. Fellasen aɛaqeb uqsiḥ, ilmend n wayen ţţandin.
6:125: Win Ibɣa Ṛebbi a t Inhu, ad illi idmaren is ar wannuz. Win Ibɣa a t Itlef, ad Irr idmaren is deyqen, tḥeyyṛen, amzun iţţaɛṛaḍ ad iali s igenni. Akka i Iţţara Ṛebbi axerwaɛ i wid ur numin.
6:126: Wagi d abrid uwqim n Mass ik. Niɣ Nessefham issekniyen i ugdud ismektayen.
6:127: I nitni, axxam n tifrat ar Mass nnsen. Neţţa d Bab nnsen, ɣef wayen xeddmen.
6:128: Ass ideg ara ten Ifser meṛṛa: "a yagraw n leonun, niɣ tcerrɛem deg imdanen"? A d inin imawlan nnsen, seg imdanen: "a Mass nneɣ! Kra segneɣ ɣelten si kra, Nebbweḍ ar lajel nneɣ, i ɣ Terriḍ". Inna: "d times ay d tanezduɣt nnwen, ad degs twekkṛem, siwa ma ur aS ihwi i Ṛebbi". Ih, Mass ik d Bab n ṣṣwab, d Amusnaw.
6:129: Akka ay Neţţara kra imednas d iḥbiben n kra, ilmend n wayen keţţben.
6:130: "A yagraw n leonun d yimdanen, day ur kwen id usan ara imazanen segwen? Mmalen awen issekniyen iW, nedṛen kwen ɣef temlilit n wass nnwen agi". Nnan d: "ncehhed ɣef yiman nneɣ". Tɣuṛṛ iten tmeddurt n ddunit. Cehhden ɣef yiman nnsen ar nitni, s tideţ, llan d ijehliyen.
6:131: Akka, acku Mass ik ur Isquccu tamdint, s ddens, ma llan imezdaɣ is d iɣwefliyen.
6:132: I yal yiwen, tiseddarin seg wayen ixdem. Ur Iɣeffel Mass ik ɣef wayen xeddmen.
6:133: Mass ik d Asɛay, d Bab uḥunu. Ma ihwa yaS a kwen Ikkes, a d Inṣef, deffir wen, ayen i S ihwan, akken ikwen id Ixleq si tarwa n ugdud nniḍen.
6:134: Ih, ayen i wen iţţuɛahden, a d ias, war ccekk. Ur tezmirem, kunwi, a ţţesfunngem.
6:135: Ini: "a yagdud iw! Xedmet akken tewɛam, nek ad xedmeɣ. Deqqal a ţţeẓṛem iwumi ara telhu taggara n Uxxam". S tideţ, ur rebḥen imednas.
6:136: Gan aS i Ṛebbi amur, seg wayen id Ifka n lɣella, akked lmal. Nnan: "wagi i Ṛebbi –- di tikta nnsen -, wagi i icriken nneɣ". Ayen gan i icriken nnsen, ur iţţaweḍ ar Ṛebbi. Ayen gan i Ṛebbi, neţţa, ad yaweḍ ar icriken nnsen. I icmet wayen id ţḥuddun!
6:137: Akka ay cebbḥen icriken nnsen, i waṭas n yimcurak, timenɣiwt n tarwa nnsen, iwakken a ten squccen, u ad irwi ddin nnsen, fellasen. Lemmer i S ihwi i Ṛebbi, ur ţ xeddmen. Eoo iten ar wayen d snulfuyen.
6:138: Nnan: "lmal akked lɣella yagi ţţugedlen, ur ten iteţţ, siwa win i ɣ ihwan". S tikta nnsen. Lmal iwumi gedlen iɛrar nnsen, lmal iwumi ur d ţţadren fellasen, isem n Ṛebbi. D asnulfu mgal iS. A ten Iqeṭṭi ɣef wayen d snulfuyen.
6:139: Qqaṛen: "ayen illan deg iɛabbaḍ n lmal agi, i ddker nneɣ kan, iţwagdel i tlawin nneɣ". Ma ilul ed immut, ad mlilen ɣuṛes. A ten Iqeṭṭi ɣef wayen d qqaṛen. Neţţa, s tideţ, d Bab n ṣṣwab, d Amusnaw.
6:140: Niɣ xesṛen wid inɣan arraw nnsen. D tiderwect, war tussna. Gedlen ayen i s iten Iɣat Ṛebbi, snulfan d mgal Ṛebbi. Niɣ nnetlafen, ur ţwanhan.
6:141: D Neţţa id Ixelqen leonanat s iɛricen, neɣ war iɛricen, tizdayin, zerriɛa n yal ṣṣenf, i wučči; azemmur akked rreman iţţemcabin, neɣ ur neţţemcabi. Eččet si ţţemṛa nnsen, ma fkan d, efket leḥqq is, ass uɣellet nnsen. Ur ssugutet. Neţţa, s tideţ, ur Iḥemmel ara wid iţḥawalen.
6:142: Si lmal, aggway d wussu. Eččet seg wayen ikwen Iṛẓeq Ṛebbi. Ur teddut d iberdan n Cciṭan. Neţţa, s tideţ, d acengu nnwen n ṣṣeḥ.
6:143: Ṭamt tyugiwin, snat uɣwelmi, snat umɛiz. Ini: "d sin n ddker i Igdel, neɣ d snat n nnta, neɣ d ayen illan deg iɛabbaḍ n snat n nnta? Xebbṛet iyi d, s tussna, ma tessawalem tideţ".
6:144: Seg ileɣwman, snat, seg ubeqṛi, snat. Ini: "d sin n ddker i Igdel, neɣ d snat n nnta, neɣ d ayen illan deg iɛabbaḍ n snat n nnta, neɣ tellam d inagan mi kwen id Iweṣṣa Ṛebbi ɣef waya"? Anwa idensen sennig win id igren tikerkas ɣef Ṛebbi, iwakken ad itlef imdanen, ur issin. Ih, Ṛebbi ur Inehhu agdud imednas.
6:145: Ini: "ur ufiɣ iţwagdel a t ičč yiwen, deg wayen iyi d iţţuweḥḥan, siwa ma illa d loifa, neɣ d idim immaren, neɣ d aksum n yilef - wagi, war ccekk, d lewsex -, neɣ ṭḥegga s dɣwel i war Ṛebbi. Win iɣef iţţuḥeţţem, ur ibɣi, ur ibɣwiḍ, Mass ik, s tideţ, Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
6:146: I wudayen, Negdel ayen akw isɛan acaren, seg ubeqṛi akked uɣwelmi, Negdel asen tassemt nnsen, siwa tin n iɛrar nnsen, iɛabbaḍ, akked wayen iţwaxelḍen akked iɣsan. Akka ay ten Neţkafi, ilmend n ṭṭeṛṛ nnsen. Nekwni, war ccekk, d At Tideţ.
6:147: Ma skaddben k, ini: "Mass nnwen d Bab uḥunu iwsɛan, ur iţwexxiṛ ssexḍ iS, af ugdud ibeɣwḍiyen".
6:148: Ad inin imcurak: "lemmer i S ihwi i Ṛebbi, nekwni akked imezwura nneɣ, ur ncurek, ur negdel acemma". Akka ay skaddben imezwura nnsen, armi jeṛṛben ssexḍ nneɣ. Ini: "day tesɛam tussna ar aɣ d tesseknem? Teţţeddum kan d nnwaya, kunwi tesnulfuyem d kan".
6:149: Ini: "n Ṛebbi timenna tunṣiḥin. Lemmer i S ihwi, yili Inha kwen akw".
6:150: Ini: "awit ed inagan nnwen, ara icehhden ar Ṛebbi Igdel ayagi". Ma cehhden, ur cehhed yidsen. Ur teddu d lhawiyya n wid iskaddben issekniyen nneɣ, akked wid ur numin s laxeṛt, u ţţaran tanudda i Mass nnsen.
6:151: Ini: "yyaw, ad iniɣ. I wen Igdel Mass nnwen: ur aS teţcarakem acemma; elhut ar imawlan nnwen; ur neqqet tarwa nnwen, di tigullelt - d Nekwni ara kwen Iṛeẓqen yidsen -, ur ţţaẓet ar lɛaṛ, d uḍhiṛ neɣ d uffir; ur neqqet amdan, d ayen Igdel Ṛebbi, siwa ma s lḥeqq". Ar waya i kwen Iweṣṣa, amar a ţfehmem.
6:152: Ur ţqeṛṛibet s ayla ugujil, siwa s wayen ilhan, alamma immeḥtel. Weznet, ktilet s lewqama. Ur Neţkellif amdan siwa ar wayen iwumi izmer. Ma thedṛem d, weznet, xas ma ɣeṛ llzem nnwen. Qadṛet lemɛahda n Ṛebbi. Iweṣṣa kwen ɣef waya, amar a d temmektim.
6:153: D wagi ay d abrid iW uwqim, ddut degs. Ur teddut d iberdan ara kwen isṭixṛen seg ubrid iS. Iweṣṣa kwen ɣef waya, amar a ţḥezzbem.
6:154: Sinna, Nefka Tazmamt i Musa. Tewqem i wid imaɛnen, tfeṣṣel yal cci, d nnhaya u d aḥunu. Amar ad amnen s timlilit n Mass nnsen.
6:155: Tagi d Tazmamt, Nessers iţ id, teṛqa. Ihi, ddut yides, ḥezzbet, amar fellawen aḥunu.
6:156: Ur d teqqaṛem ara: "ters ed kan Tezmamt ɣeṛ sin leoyus, uqbel nneɣ, ur neẓṛi d acu sselmaden".
6:157: Neɣ a d tinim: "lemmer id ters Tazmamt ɣuṛneɣ, yili nif iten akken neţwanha". Niɣ iusa kwen id ubeggen, sɣuṛ Mass nnwen, d nnhaya u d aḥunu. Anwa idensen sennig win iskaddben issekniyen n Ṛebbi, u iooa iten? A Nqeṭṭi wid iooan issekniyen nneɣ, s yir aɛaqeb, ilmend n wayen la ţţaooan.
6:158: D acu ţṛaoun, siwa ma ten id asent lmalayek, neɣ a d Ias Mass ik, neɣ a d asen kra issekniyen n Mass ik? Ass ideg ara d asen kra issekniyen n Mass ik, ur infaɛ umdan liman is, ma, iuɣ lḥal, ur iumin ara, neɣ ur iksib lxiṛ, di liman is. Ini: "gganit, nekwni, ih, la neţgani".
6:159: Ih, wid ibḍan ddin nnsen, u gan ikabaren, ur teţkkiḍ yidsen deg wacemma. Lameṛ nnsen ar Ṛebbi kan, sinna, a ten Ixebbeṛ ɣef wayen xeddmen.
6:160: Win id iusan s yiseɣ, ines mraw i t icban; win id iusan s tucmiţ, ad iţţuqeṭṭi s tin kan i ţ icban; nitni ur ţwadensen.
6:161: Ini: "nek, Inha iyi Mass iw, ar ubrid uwqim, d ddin n ddwam, win n Ibṛahim, i imalen ar tideţ, ur nelli seg imcurak".
6:162: Ini: "ih, taẓallit iw, iseflan iw, tudert iw, tameţţant iw, i Ṛebbi, Mass imaḍalen.
6:163: Ur aS illi ucarek. Pwamṛeɣ d s waya: nek d amduɛ amenzu".
6:164: Ini: "day bɣiɣ mass, war Ṛebbi? U Neţţa d Mass n yal cci". Ur ikesseb yal yiman, siwa mgal is. Ur iţbibbi win ibubben taɛkkwemt n wayeḍ. Sinna, ar Mass nnwen, tuɣalin nnwen. Sinna, a kwen Ixebbeṛ ɣef wayen tellam temgaradem.
6:165: D Neţţa i kwen Irran d igensas di tmurt. Irra, kra segwen, tiseddaṛin sennig wiyaḍ, iwakken a kwen Ijeṛṛeb ɣef wayen i wen Ifka. Ih, Mass ik Iţɣawal deg uɛaqeb. Neţţa, s tideţ, Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
7:2: Tazmamt ters ed ɣuṛek, ur teţţili segs lhejna deg idmaren ik, iwakken a ţnabiḍ yis; u d asmekti i lmumnin.
7:3: Ddut d wayen id irsen ɣuṛwen, sɣuṛ Mass nnwen. Ur teddut d imawlan, war Neţţa. Drus id tesmektayem.
7:4: Acḥal n temdinin ay Nessenger. Tusa ten id tiyta nneɣ, deg iḍes nnsen, neɣ deg uqeggel nnsen.
7:5: Tiɣṛi nnsen, mi ten id tusa tiyta nneɣ, siwa mi d nnan: "ih, nella d imednas".
7:6: War ccekk, a Nesteqsi wid uɣuṛ id Nuzen, a Nesteqsi imazanen.
7:7: War ccekk, ad asen Neḥku, s tmusni, ur Nelli Nɣab.
7:8: Awzan, assen, d tideţ. Wid iwumi ẓẓayet lweznat nnsen, widak d wid irebḥen.
7:9: Wid iwumi fessuset lweznat nnsen, widak d wid ixesṛen iman nnsen, seg akken sednasen issekniyen nneɣ.
7:10: Niɣ, s tideţ, Nesrekd ikwen di tmurt, Nerra yawen, degs, tamɛict nnwen. Drus ay tesnemmirem.
7:11: Niɣ, s tideţ, Nxelq ikwen, sinna, Nmesl ikwen, sinna, Nenna i lmalayek: "knumt i Adem"! Knant, siwa Iblis. Ur illi seg wid iknan.
7:12: Inna: "acu k iṭṭfen ur tekniḍ ara, mi k d Umṛeɣ"? Inna d: "Nek, ifeɣ t. Txelqeḍ iyi si tmes, Txelqeḍ t si talaxt".
7:13: Inna: "ihi, ṣṣub segs! Ur ak iţţunefk ara a ţţesmeɣwṛeḍ iman ik, degs. Effeɣ, kečč seg wid ixuṣen"!
7:14: Inna: "Eoo iyi, ar ass ideg ara d kkren".
7:16: Inna d: "imi iyi Tɛammdeḍ aɣewwu, ad asen qqimeɣ, war ccekk, deg ubrid iK uwqim.
7:17: Sinna, ad asen d tekkeɣ zdat, deffir, yeffus, zelmeḍ. Ur Teţţafeḍ, ɣeṛ tugwti segsen, asnemmer".
7:18: Inna: "effeɣ segs, d ameḥquṛ iţţuḍegṛen! War ccekk, ad Acaṛeɣ Loahennama s wid, segsen, i k iḍefṛen, akked yiswen akw.
7:19: A Adem, ezdeɣ Loennet, kečč akked tmeṭṭut ik, eččet seg wayen i wen ihwan. Ur ţqeṛṛibet ttejṛa agi, mulac a ţţilim seg imednas".
7:20: Iɣewwa ten Cciṭan, iwakken ad asen d iban ɛaryan nnsen i illan iffer. Inna: "Ikkes awen, kan, Mass nnwen, ttejṛa agi, iwakken ur teţţilim d lmalayek, neɣ ur teţwekkiṛem".
7:22: Isdull iten s uɣuṛṛu. Mi ɛaṛḍen si ttejṛa nni, walan iman nnsen aɛran. Lhan d la ţcuddun, ɣef iman nnsen, afriwen n Loennet. Issawel asen d Mass nnsen: "day ur awen Gdileɣ ara ttejṛa nni? Ad awen Iniɣ: war ccekk, Cciṭan, i kunwi, d acengu n ṣṣeḥ".
7:23: Nnan: "a Mass nneɣ! Nḍuṛṛ iman nneɣ. Ma ur aɣ Tsemmḥeḍ, ur Tḥuneḍ fellaɣ, a nili seg imexsuṛen".
7:24: Inna: "erset! Kra d icenga n kra. A ţzedɣem di tmurt, a ţţezhum, tallit kan".
7:25: Irna: "degs a ţţidirem, degs a ţţemmtem, segs a d teffɣem".
7:26: A tarwa n Adem! Niɣ Nessers awen ed aceṭṭiḍ ara kwen issṛen, ṛṛḥuḥ, akked uceṭṭiḍ uḥezzeb. Wagi yif iten". Ayagi seg issekniyen n Ṛebbi, amar a d mmektin.
7:27: A tarwa n Adem! ɣuṛwat a kwen ihewwel Cciṭan, akken id issuffeɣ imezwura nnwen si Loennet! Ikkes asen iceṭṭiḍen nnsen, iwakken ad asen issken ɛaryan nnsen. Neţţa, war ccekk, iţwali kwen - neţţa akked ccetla s - seg wanda ur ten teţwalim. Niɣ Nerra ccwaṭen d imawlan n wid ur numin.
7:28: Mi xedmen ayen n dir, ad inin: "nufa d akka ar imezwura nneɣ, u Ṛebbi Iumeṛ aɣ d ɣuṛes. Ini: "Ṛebbi, s tideţ, ur Iţţameṛ ar wayen n dir. Day a d tinim ɣef Ṛebbi, ayen ur tessinem"?
7:29: Ini: "Iumeṛ ed Ṛebbi lmizan. Zzit ɣuṛeS udmawen nnwen di yal lekni, nujet ɣuṛeS. ɣuṛeS, s ddin iṣfan. Akken ikwen id Ixleq, a ţţuɣalem".
7:30: Arbaɛ Inha it, arbaɛ iura ttelfan fellas. Nitni, s tideţ, rran ccwaṭen d iḥbiben, war Ṛebbi. U ɣilen nitni, war ccekk, ţwanhan.
7:31: A tarwa n Adem! Ccebḥet i yal lekni, eččet, esswet, ur sṭuqqutet. Neţţa, s tideţ, ur Iḥemmel ara wid isṭuqquten.
7:32: Ini: "anwa i igedlen ccbaḥa n Ṛebbi, id Issuffeɣ i imdanen iS, akked ṛṛeẓq ilhan"? Ini: "ayagi, di tmeddurt n ddunit, i wid iumnen. I nitni kan ass n tnekra". Akka ay Nfeṣṣel issekniyen i ugdud issnen.
7:33: Ini: "Mass iw Igdel kan ayen n dir, d uḍhiṛ neɣ d uffir, abekkaḍ, temɣweṛ war ssebba, a ţcarkem i Ṛebbi ayen iwumi ur d irs udabu, a ţţinim ɣef Ṛebbi ayen ur tessinem".
7:34: Yal lois isɛa lajel. Ma iusa d lajel nnsen, ur t swexxiṛen s ssaɛa, ur t id ẓẓaẓan.
7:35: A tarwa n Adem! Ma usan kwen id imazanen segwen, mmalen awen issekniyen iW, wid iţḥezziben, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ur ţţagwaden, ur ɣweblen.
7:36: Wid iskaddben issekniyen nneɣ, u smeɣwṛen iman nnsen fellasen, widak d at tmes, nitni degs ad wekkṛen.
7:37: Anwa idensen sennig win id igren tikerkas ɣef Ṛebbi, neɣ iskaddben issekniyen iS? Widak, a ten iḥaz umur i sen iuran di Tezmamt. Alamma, mi ten id usan imceggɛen nneɣ, ad ddmen leṛwaḥ nnsen, ad inin: "anida ten wid uɣuṛ teţnujum, war Ṛebbi"? A d inin: "ur ten nufi". Ad cehhden, ɣef yiman nnsen, ar nitni llan d ijehliyen.
7:38: Inna: "kecmet di tmes ar leoyus n leonun akked yimdanen, i kwen id izwaren"! Yal tikelt ara ikcem lois, ad ixzu gma s. Alamma, mi mlalen degs akw, ad yini uneggaru nnsen ɣef umezwaru nnsen: "a Mass nneɣ! Wigi telfen aɣ, Aɛqeb iten s tmes, berdayen". Inna: "i yal yiwen berdayen, maca ur teẓṛim ara".
7:39: Inna umezwaru nnsen i uneggaru nnsen: "ur kwen smenyafen i nekwni, ihi jeṛṛbet aɛaqeb, ilmend n wayen tkeţţbem".
7:40: Ih, wid iskaddben issekniyen nneɣ, u smeɣwṛen iman nnsen fellasen, ur asen tellin tibbura igenni, ur kečmen Loennet, skud ur iɛadda ara ulɣem di tiṭ n tsegnit. Akka ay Neţqeṭṭi ibeɣwḍiyen.
7:41: I nitni ameṭṛeḥ di Loahennama, ad ɣummen s tmes. Akka ay Neţqeṭṭi imednas.
7:42: Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan - ur Neţkellif i umdan siwa ayen iwumi izmer - widak, d at Loennet, nitni, degs, ad wekkṛen.
7:43: A Nekkes i d igwran n ddɣel, deg idmaren nnsen. Isaffen ad ţţazzalen ddawat sen. Ad inin: "ccekṛan i Ṛebbi i ɣ Inhan ɣeṛ waya. Ur neţwanhu, lemmer ur aɣ Inha ara Ṛebbi. Niɣ usan d imazanen n Mass nneɣ, s tideţ". Ad ţwanecden: "aţţan Loennet, tweṛtem ţ, ilmend n wayen txeddmem".
7:44: At Loennet ad siwlen i at tmes: "niɣ nufa i ɣ Iɛahed Mass nneɣ, s tideţ. Ma tufam ayen i wen Iɛahed Mass nnwen, s tideţ"? A inin: "Ih". Iberreḥ uberraḥ garasen: "xezzu n Ṛebbi i imednas,
7:45: wid iṭṭeṛṛifen seg ubrid n Ṛebbi, ssaramen t d uɛwij, u nekṛen laxeṛt".
7:46: Garasen ssteṛ. ɣef iqacucen, irgazen, ssnen ten akw, ar ṣṣiffat nnsen. Ad siwlen i at Loennet: "tifrat fellawen"! Ur ţ keččmen, xas ssarmen.
7:47: Mi zzint wallen nnsen ar at tmes, ad inin: "a Mass nneɣ! Ur aɣ Pţara s agdud imednas"!
7:48: Ad siwlen at iqacucen i irgazen, ssnen ten ar ṣṣiffat nnsen. Ad inin: "acu i wen d issuli wayen tjemɛam akked wayen tzuxxem"?
7:49: Day wigi d wid iɣef teggulem, ar ur sen iţţak Ṛebbi aḥunu? "Kecmet Loennet, ur teţţagwadem, ur tɣweblem".
7:50: At tmes ad siwlen i at Loennet: "smiret ed fellaneɣ aman, neɣ seg wayen is ikwen Iɣat Ṛebbi". Ad inin: "Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Igdel iten i ijehliyen,
7:51: wid irran ddin nnsen d zzhu, d urar, u tɣuṛṛ iten tmeddurt n ddunit". Ihi, assa, a ten Neţţu, akken ţţun timlilit n wass nnsen agi, u nekṛen issekniyen nneɣ.
7:52: Niɣ Nusa ten id s Tezmamt, Nfeṣṣel iţ s tussna. D nnhaya, d aḥunu i ugdud iumnen.
7:53: Day la ţṛaoun kan ḍeṛṛu s? Ass n tisin n ḍeṛṛu s, ad inin wid illan, iuɣ lḥal, ţţun ţ: "niɣ usan d imazanen n Mass nneɣ, s tideţ. Day nesɛa imcafɛen ara ɣ icafɛen, neɣ ad aɣ rren, a nexdem ayen mgirrden wayen nxeddem"? Niɣ sxeṣṛen iman nnsen. Itelf iten wayen d snulfuyen.
7:54: S tideţ, Mass nnwen d Ṛebbi. Ixelq ed tamurt akked igenwan di sdis wussan, sinna, Iɛannec ɣef usgeld. Iţɣummu iḍ s wass, iţɣawalen ɣuṛes. Iṭij, aggur, akked yitran unzen i lameṛ iS. Day mačči ineS lxelq akked lameṛ? D Asaɛdi Ṛebbi, Mass imaḍalen!
7:55: Naɛret Mass nnwen, s wannuz, di tbaḍnit. Neţţa, s tideţ, ur Iḥemmel ara wid izegren tilas.
7:56: Ur ssefsadet di tmurt deffir useḥṛet is. Naɛṛet eP, s tugwdi d usirem. Aḥunu n Ṛebbi, s tideţ, ar tama n lɛuṣam.
7:57: D Neţţa id Iţţaznen aḍu, d abecceṛ s uḥunu S. Alamma, ma ibbub ed asigna aẓayan, Nenheṛ it ar tmurt immuten. Nesseɣli d syis aman. Nessuffeɣ ed yissen yal ţţemṛa. Akka ay d Nessuffuɣ lmeggtin, amendeṛ ma d tesmektim.
7:58: Di tmurt lɛali, teffɣen d imɣan is, ma Irad Ṛebbi. Di tin icemten, teffɣen d kan d iweqweqen. Akka ay Neţbeggin issekniyen i ugdud isnemmiren.
7:59: Niɣ Nuzen ed Nuḥ i ugdud is. Inna: "a yagdud iw! Ɛabdet Ṛebbi! Ur tesɛim ṛebbi war Neţţa. Nek ugadeɣ fellawen aɛaqeb, ass ameqwṛaḥan".
7:60: Nnan imḍebbṛen n ugdud is: "ɣuṛneɣ, s tideţ, aql ak di ttelfan n ṣṣeḥ".
7:61: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Ur illi dgi ttelfan. Maca nek d amazan sɣuṛ Mass imaḍalen.
7:62: Bbwiɣ awen d tibratin n Mass iw, a kwen neṣḥeɣ. Ssneɣ, sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, ayen ur tessinem.
7:63: Day twehmem mi kwen id iusa usmekti sɣuṛ Mass nnwen, ibbwi t id urgaz segwen, iwakken a kwen inabi, iwakken a ţḥezzbem, amar fellawen aḥunu"?
7:64: Skaddben t. Nsellek it, akked wid illan yides, di lbabuṛ. Neɣmeq wid iskaddben issekniyen nneɣ. Nitni, s tideţ, d agdud aderɣal.
7:65: Ar Ɛad, gmat sen Hud. Inna: "a yagdud iw! Ɛabdet Ṛebbi! Ur tesɛim ṛebbi, war Neţţa. Day ur teţḥezziben ara"?
7:66: Nnan imḍebbṛen, wid ijehlen seg ugdud is: "s tideţ, ɣuṛneɣ, deg k tisselbi; ɣuṛneɣ, ih, kečč seg wid iskiddiben".
7:67: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Ur dgi tisselbi. Maca nek d amazan sɣuṛ Mass imaḍalen.
7:68: Bbwiɣ awen d tibratin n Mass iw. Nek, i kunwi, d aneṣṣaḥ muman.
7:69: Day twehmem mi kwen id iusa usmekti sɣuṛ Mass nnwen, ibbwi t id urgaz segwen, iwakken a kwen inabi. Mmektit ed mi kwen Irra d igensas, deffir ugdud n Nuḥ. Isemɣweṛ aṭas lqedd nnwen. Mmektit ed lxiṛ n Ṛebbi, amar a ţrebḥem".
7:70: Nnan: "day aɣ d tusiḍ, iwakken a naɛbed Ṛebbi Yiwen, a neoo ayen llan ɛabden imezwura nneɣ? Awi yaɣ d ayen is la ɣ tessagwadeḍ, ma d tideţ ay tessawaleḍ".
7:71: Inna: "niɣ iwwet ikwen id ddell akked zzɛaf sɣuṛ Mass nnwen. Day ad iyi namren ɣef ismawen i tefkam, kunwi akked imezwura nnwen, i wid iwumi ur d Issers Ṛebbi kra udabu. Ihi, gganit, nek yidwen seg wid ara igganin".
7:72: Nsellek it, akked wid illan yides, s uḥunu sɣuṛneɣ. Nessenger wid iskaddben issekniyen nneɣ, ur nelli d lmumnin.
7:73: ɣuṛ Tamud, gmat sen Ṣaliḥ. Inna: "a yagdud iw! Ɛabdet Ṛebbi! Ur tesɛim ṛebbi war Neţţa. Niɣ iusa kwen id ubeggen sɣuṛ Mass nnwen. Talɣwemt agi n Ṛebbi, d assekni i kunwi. Ooet eţ a ţţečč di tmurt n Ṛebbi. Ur ţ ṭṭuṛṛut, mulac a kwen iḥaz uɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
7:74: Mmektit ed mi kwen Irra d igensas, deffir Ɛad. Isseqɛad ikwen di tmurt, teţţarram lebṛuj di swaḥel, teqqazem ixxamen deg durar. Ihi, mmektit ed lxiṛ n Ṛebbi, ur ssexsaṛet tamurt, s usefsed".
7:75: Imḍebbṛen seg ugdud is, wid ismeɣawṛen iman nnsen, nnan i wuṛhifen, wid segsen iumnen: "day teẓṛam ar ṢṢaliḥ d amazan sɣuṛ Mass is"? Nnan: "ih, numen s wayen is id iţţuceggaɛ".
7:76: Nnan imzuxiyen: "nekwni, s tideţ, nenkeṛ ayen is tumnem".
7:77: Ḥerrfen aḍaṛ n telɣwemt, gelzen lameṛ n Mass nnsen. Nnan: "a Ṣaliḥ, awi yaɣ d ayen is la ɣ tessagwadeḍ, ma d amazan ay telliḍ".
7:78: Tewwet iten zzenzla, gwran d, deg ixxamen nnsen, d loeţţat.
7:79: Iwexxeṛ asen, u inna: "a yagdud iw! Niɣ ssawḍeɣ awen d tabṛaţ n Mass iw, neṣḥeɣ kwen, maca ur tḥemmlem ara win ineṣḥen".
7:80: I Luṭ, mi inna i ugdud is: "day a txeddmem lɛaṛ ur ixdim yiwen, uqbel nnwen, deg imaḍalen?
7:81: Ih, kunwi tţeddum ar irgazen, tcehwam ten, war tilawin. Kunwi, ih, d agdud izegren tilas".
7:82: Tiririt n ugdud is siwa nnan: "ssuffɣet ţen si temdint nnwen, nitni d imdanen issaramen tezdeg".
7:83: Nsellek it, neţţa akked twacult is, siwa tameṭṭut is, teqqim akked wid igwran.
7:84: Nesseɣli d fellasen ageffur…Wali amek teḍṛa d ibeɣwḍiyen.
7:85: ɣuṛ Madian, gmat sen Cuɛayeb. Inna: "a yagdud iw! Ɛabdet Ṛebbi! Ur tesɛim ṛebbi war Neţţa. Niɣ iusa kwen id ubeggen sɣuṛ Mass nnwen. Ktilet, weznet, s lewqama. Ur ṭṭuṛṛut medden di cci nnsen, ur ssefsadet di tmurt, deffir useḥṛet is. I kunwi yif it wayagi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.
7:86: Ur ţɣimit di yal abrid, tessagwadem u tessefṛaɣem seg ubrid n Ṛebbi, wid iumnen yiS. Tebɣam t d uɛwij. Mmektit ed mi tellam d takwemmict, Iketteṛ ikwen. Walit amek teḍṛa taggara ifessaden.
7:87: Ma illa iumen urbaɛ segwen s wayen is id ţţuceggɛaɣ, arbaɛ nniḍen ur iumin ara. Ṣebṛet ard Iḥudd Ṛebbi garaneɣ. Neţţa Yif akw imḥaddan".
